STATEMENT OF COMMITMENT

I, __________________________________________, as parent/guardian of _________________________________, promise to confer with my child’s Adviser, whether electronically or face-to-face (thus, observing social distancing and other minimum health standards) regarding my child’s behavior and academic progress. I understand that I am liable for my child’s learning process.

Furthermore, I hereby agree to abide the policies and regulations of the school including the following:

  • Administrative policies;
  • Prompt payment of tuition fees and other school fees;
  • That our personal information shall be kept confidential. However, we allow transfer, whether electronically or hardcopy and submit to legitimate offices and Agencies, who are collating learners’ information for the benefit of the school and ourselves;
  • That this e-learning/ homeschool programs offer the following subjects as appropriate in his/her Grade level, Christian Living & Values Education (CLVE), Technology & Livelihood Education (TLE)/ Edukasyong Pantahanan at Pangkabuhayan (EPP), Araling Panlipunan, Science, Mathematics, Filipino and English.
I recognize that the implementation of these rules will contribute to the welfare of my child and will lead to the attainment of the objectives of St. Lorenzo Ruiz Academy of Tagum, Inc..
